# Nightly signing or publication failure

- Run: [456](https://github.com/Gvetri/Mercurio/actions/runs/456)
- Attempt: `2`
- Commit: `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`

## Failed stages

- `publish`: `failure`

## Retained release state

- Source SHA: `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`
- Version code: `7002`
- Tag: `nightly-7002-bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`
- Release id: `1`
- Created release id (creation response only): `1`
- Release state: `draft`
- Incomplete draft: `yes`
- Tag exists: `no`
- Orphan tag: `no`
- Snapshot read back by the publication job after refusal; not a live recovery authorization. Source/version/tag without a release id are the intended identity, not proof a release exists.

An incomplete draft means the read-back found a draft with an incomplete asset inventory. A draft with all asset names has unknown completeness: bytes have not been verified here. A tag attached to a read-back draft is not orphaned yet; removing that draft may orphan it. A tag with no listed release has unknown orphan status because listings may omit drafts.

## Available diagnostic artifacts

- [nightly-publication-state-456-2](https://github.com/Gvetri/Mercurio/actions/runs/456/artifacts/31)
- unsigned-release-456-2: missing or expired; inspect the failed job logs.
- signed-release-456-2: missing or expired; inspect the failed job logs.

Release state changes: at most one well-formed retained draft for this exact source is discarded per publish attempt, after a fresh validation; this attempt may have discarded the draft of an earlier attempt before it created the draft above. No workflow deletes a published release or an asset, overwrites an asset, or re-publishes a release. Follow the agent recovery rule in [Development Nightly releases](https://github.com/Gvetri/Mercurio/blob/main/docs/nightly-releases.md). Never touch a published release or an asset; unknown state requires inspection.
